name: Twilight_Echo
body:
# Twilight Echo v1.3.1

_界面退场，音乐继续。_

1.3.1 在 1.3.0 的基础上加入余晖模式、全窗口插件体验与灵动岛，并完善快捷键、页面历史、网络音乐源和原生音频稳定性。此前 1.3.1-preview 中的修复已全部包含在正式版中。

> [!NOTE]
> **对比范围：1.3.0 → 1.3.1 正式版。** 本说明以 **1.3.0 正式版** 为对比基线，包含 1.3.1-preview 的修复与预览期之后合入的改动。

## 本次更新重点

- **余晖模式（Afterglow）**：卸载全部界面渲染器释放内存，由原生音频引擎继续播放；托盘、媒体键、系统媒体控制和局域网遥控仍可操作，随时恢复界面且不中断播放。
- **全窗口插件体验**：插件 API v4 与 bridge v2 预览，插件可以在宿主窗口内提供完整的音乐工作区；Rhine 0.2.1 作为本地预览示例。
- **灵动岛**：宿主拥有的置顶 overlay 窗口，支持跟随主窗口、歌词显示、播放控制和 DIY 配置。
- **可配置快捷键与页面历史**：应用内快捷键可查看占用状态并自定义；鼠标侧键可以在页面历史中前进和后退。
- **网络音乐源与在线内容**：改进 WebDAV 浏览、认证和传输，补齐 FTP／SFTP／SMB／NFS／DLNA 行为；在线歌单支持分组与分页，网易云专辑增加发行筛选与标识。
- **原生音频与诊断**：继续完善 ASIO 设备协商、缓冲与 Native DSD 边界；诊断日志可跨进程持久化，并可恢复卡住的音频服务。
- **性能与内存**：歌曲列表虚拟化与顺滑回到顶部，限制壁纸、封面和主题素材的图片内存，降低长时间使用后的内存占用。

---

## 新增与扩展功能

### 1. 余晖模式（Afterglow）

_把界面收起来，让音乐留在后台。_

- 设置 → **系统与关于 → 运行与性能 → 余晖模式（Afterglow）** 可以立即进入，或选择在最小化／隐藏到托盘时自动进入。
- 进入后渲染器完全卸载，主进程、原生音频服务和（启用时的）GPU 进程继续运行。
- 恢复方式包括托盘菜单、单击／双击托盘图标、`Ctrl/⌘+Shift+E`（冲突时自动回退备用组合）、再次启动应用、Windows 任务栏图标和 macOS Dock。
- 恢复时渲染器采纳引擎的实时队列、曲目、进度、播放态、音量和倍速，不会重新加载队列，也不会打断正在播放的音频。
- 卸载期间仍可使用托盘传输控制、全局快捷键与媒体键、Windows SMTC、局域网遥控、Discord 状态和睡眠定时器。
- 只有原生引擎已完整接管且音源可继续播放时才会进入；流媒体 URL 通过原生队列热更新在后台续接，失败或队列播完会自动恢复界面，不会留下不可见的停止播放器。
- 详细条件、限制与实现位置见 [`docs/afterglow-mode.md`](../afterglow-mode.md)。

### 2. 全窗口插件体验与灵动岛

_插件不再只是侧栏里的一个页面。_

- 插件 API v4 新增 `ui` 类型与 `contributes.experiences`，通过受限的 `plugin-ui://` 协议、CSP 和 iframe 沙箱承载。
- bridge v2 使用一次性 MessagePort 与白名单操作，覆盖曲库读写、播放控制与观察、私有偏好、窗口退出／全屏等能力。
- 插件打开、关闭或替换体验视图不会隐式停止宿主播放；封面等本地资源通过受控句柄访问。
- Rhine 0.2.1 预览展示完整的曲库、队列、歌单、音频／EQ、DSP、下载和设置工作区；托盘、迷你播放器和桌面歌词可使用 Rhine 皮肤。
- 灵动岛通过 `twilight.overlay` 由插件配置，宿主负责窗口生命周期、几何、原生圆角裁剪和配置校验；歌词走独立通道，避免重复序列化。
- 详见 [`docs/plugin-experiences.md`](../plugin-experiences.md) 与 [`docs/dynamic-island.md`](../dynamic-island.md)。

### 3. 快捷键、页面历史与导航

- 应用内快捷键集中配置，并显示注册结果和占用状态，冲突时不再静默失败。
- Windows／Linux 鼠标侧键通过窗口 `app-command` 转发到渲染器的页面历史栈，并对重复投递去重。
- 页面历史与前进／后退状态和现有页面恢复逻辑统一，重启后仍能回到上次浏览位置。

name: motrix-next
body:
## What's Changed

This beta bundles Aria2 Next 3.0.6, which shares a server's connections fairly across downloads and keeps parallel connections for servers that omit Content-Range. Lightweight mode now frees every webview in the tray, the floating orb tells seeding from downloading, and several download and add-window refinements land.

### ✨ New Features

- **Torrent links open their file list** — copying or pasting a `.torrent` link fetches it and shows its files for selection at once (#737)
- **Split archives in their category** — parts such as `.7z.001`, `.z01` and `.r00` are filed with the archive's category (#736)

### 🛠 Improvements

- **Aria2 Next 3.0.6** — downloads from one server share its connections by remaining bytes when the server limits them, so a large video no longer waits behind its audio and subtitles; a `206` without `Content-Range` keeps its parallel connections
- **Lightweight mode frees every webview** — the main window, the prepared add window, the floating orb and its panel all close in the tray, leaving only Rayburst and the engine; they return with the main window (#735)
- **Floating orb** — it fills from the bottom with the overall progress, shows the upload speed while only seeding, and marks connecting, queued and paused states with their sign and percentage; its panel opens centered on it and lists seeding torrents with their upload speed
- **Duplicate prompt from history** — a URL downloaded before is recognized even after its file was moved, renamed or deleted (#545)
- **Clipboard detection** — only links copied after Rayburst started are picked up (#738)
- **Advanced options** — resource type and "save for this site" sit lower, next to the options they belong to

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed the floating orb spinning forever while torrents only seed, and the completion check vanishing when a finished torrent starts seeding
- Fixed the main window appearing transparent and empty for a moment on launch and when reopened from the tray

name: cc-switch
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.15

本版本以修复为主：Windows 上更新后隐藏的应用、配置目录覆盖等设置会被重置为默认值的问题已修复；更新 Codex 时，`--version` 响应慢不会再把好好的 Codex 卸掉；macOS 应用图标改为白色圆角方块，macOS 26 不再把它塞进灰色底板。经路由的请求重新认得出 Claude Code 的会话，走 Codex OAuth 时的缓存键和 Claude Desktop 连 Gemini 时的签名回放都恢复正常；Codex 历史里有一条坏掉的工具调用时不再每轮都报错，DeepSeek 也不再拒收回放的工具历史。另外修复了 WebDAV/S3 慢速传输 300 秒被掐断、Windows 上「打开终端」找不到 `claude`、WSL 里的 Hermes 会话读不出、路由切换总是提示重启等问题。新增用量趋势图的柱形图 / 曲线面积图切换、Hermes 按模型声明图片输入，Claude Desktop 表单也能为 Copilot 等托管登录的供应商获取模型列表。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.15-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.15-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

**用量趋势图可以选柱形图或曲线面积图**（[#8406](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8406)）。在用量页「设置」页签的「显示」区，「趋势图样式」可以选柱形图（默认）或曲线面积图，两种样式的指标、坐标轴、悬停提示和币种换算都一样。「显示」区的几项设置也重新排成了对齐的两列，汇率单独一行，放在币种下面。

**Hermes 可以按模型声明支持图片输入**（[#8464](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8464)）。Hermes 按每个模型的 `supports_vision` 判断能不能看图，没写的未知模型会被当成纯文本、图片被压成文字；以前表单里没有地方设置，手写的值保存后也会被冲掉。现在展开模型详情后有「支持图片输入」开关：打开写 `supports_vision: true`，关掉则删除这个键，交给 Hermes 自己判断。从模型列表选到已知支持图片的模型时会自动打开。

**Claude Desktop 可以为托管登录的供应商获取模型列表**（[#8426](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8426)）。GitHub Copilot、Codex OAuth、xAI OAuth 这类供应商以前在 Desktop 表单里没有「获取模型列表」按钮，现在有了，会按登录的账号拉取；还没登录时先提示登录。换了供应商类型或账号后，列表会清空重拉，不会混进别的账号的模型。

## 改进

**路由下切换供应商，提示写明实际做了什么**（[#8347](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8347)）。以前路由模式下切换，Codex、Gemini CLI、Grok Build 总会提示重启客户端。现在提示会说明是记住了供应商、改了路由目标、切换了路由，还是改了聚合默认供应商；只有客户端配置文件确实改了，才提示重启。

**侧栏「今日」不再带「今日」前缀。** 只选一项时也和选两项时一样只显示数值，完整说明在悬停提示里。

**Claude Code 用量导入更快**（[#8224](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8224)）。同一次导入里，查过的模型价格会复用，不再每条记录都查一遍；改了价格，下一次导入就会用上。

**土耳其语**：补齐了卸载和套餐额度相关的新文案（[#8291](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8291)）。

**预设：** 新增 EveryAPI、AllTokens。

# GitHub Stars Manager v0.8.7

## Highlights / 特性亮点

### 1. Vector Search One-Click Interactive Deployment Wizard / 向量搜索跨平台一键部署向导 (#479)
- **EN**: Introducing an end-to-end, cross-platform interactive terminal deployment wizard (TUI) for Cloudflare Worker & Vectorize semantic search. You can now deploy and configure vector search with zero manual Wrangler CLI commands or dashboard clicking!
  - Cross-platform launchers: `npm run deploy:vector`, `./deploy-vector.sh` (macOS/Linux), and double-clickable `deploy-vector.bat` or `deploy-vector.ps1` (Windows).
  - One-click browser OAuth login via Cloudflare Wrangler, automatic index creation, safe secret provisioning, and automatic local config generation.
  - Safe & smart: Automatically preserves existing remote Vectorize indices and auth secrets without data loss.
  - Redesigned Vector Search settings in the app with bilingual step-by-step guidance tabs.
- **ZH**: 推出 Cloudflare Worker 与 Vectorize 语义检索的一键交互式部署向导（TUI）。无需登录 Cloudflare 网页控制台或记忆复杂的 Wrangler 命令即可轻松完成部署与配置！
  - 跨平台便捷启动：支持 `npm run deploy:vector`、`./deploy-vector.sh`（macOS/Linux），以及 Windows 下双击 `deploy-vector.bat` 或运行 `deploy-vector.ps1`。
  - 浏览器一键 OAuth 授权登录、自动创建与探测 Vectorize 向量索引、安全注入鉴权密钥，并自动生成本地配置。
  - 智能安全保障：自动探测并严格保护远端已有的向量索引和密钥，绝不覆盖已有向量数据。
  - 应用内重构了向量搜索设置页，提供清晰明了的中英双语指引选项卡。

Release binaries no longer hand a target repository's `.env` to providers.

### Security

- Release binaries, including the Claude, Codex and Pi provider plugins and the forge-github and chat-slack plugins, no longer load `.env` or `bunfig.toml` from their working directory. In v0.12.0 a provider started in a target repository loaded that repository's `.env` and undid Archon's strip of it, so a project's `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` could reach Claude and override your subscription. Source installs were not affected. If you ran v0.12.0 in a repository whose `.env` holds provider keys, upgrade, then run `archon provider add` again for each provider you use. (#4426, #4427)

```bash
curl -fsSL https://archon.diy/install | bash
```

```powershell
irm https://archon.diy/install.ps1 | iex
```

```bash
brew install coleam00/archon/archon
```

**Docker**
```bash
docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/workspace" ghcr.io/coleam00/archon:latest workflow list
```

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/coleam00/Archon/releases/latest/download/archon-darwin-arm64 -o /usr/local/bin/archon
```

name: tiez-clipboard
body:
> **测试版**：这是 1.0.0 的测试版，可能还有问题，欢迎在测试群或 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/jimuzhe/tiez-clipboard/issues) 反馈。测试版会通过「检查更新」收到之后的测试版和正式版。

**相比 beta.7**：改进 TieZ 对自己写入剪贴板的识别。之前只比对内容，带格式内容（如公式、图片）粘贴时写出的内容和记录不同，会被当成新复制收录，还被记成粘贴目标软件的来源；现在按写入本身识别，粘贴后不再多出多余的记录。「以管理员身份自启」改为不受系统计划任务默认限制（如用电池时不启动、连续运行 3 天后被结束），在笔记本等设备上也能正常生效，下次登录 Windows 时生效。

TieZ 1.0.0 是一次大版本更新，相比上一个公开版本 **Windows v0.3.3（2026-04-11）** 重写了大部分功能。下面按使用场景列出主要变化。

## Windows 专属
- **重装系统后**：数据文件夹从旧系统带过来时，旧系统加密的密码在新系统上无法读取。TieZ 会正常启动，其他设置都在，读不出的那一项在设置里标红色「!」，点开后重新填写；无法打开的旧密钥文件会改名保留（`master.key.dpapi.unreadable`），不会删除。
- **打开文件夹**：不再在成功打开后仍提示「打开失败」。
- **WPS / Excel 带格式粘贴**：剪贴板改为一次写完，不会再被其他程序中途读取打断而粘贴失败；个别格式写不进去时跳过，不影响粘贴。
- **新图标**：换成与 macOS 一致的新图案，圆角、四周透明。
- **外观**：「磨砂」主题在 Windows 11 22H2 及以上改用真正的亚克力模糊，窗口失去焦点后依然保持（需要在系统设置中开启「透明效果」，拖动时可能略卡）；Windows 11 的窗口边框改由系统绘制，四边完整；不透明的内置主题文字更清晰。
- **开机自启**：自启时不再弹出主窗口；新增「以管理员身份自启」（需要确认一次 UAC，用电池时也能生效）。
- **粘贴方式新增「自动」（默认）**：按目标应用选择按键：QQ、Telegram、微信，以及 Chrome、Edge 等 Chromium 内核的浏览器和应用用 Ctrl+V；Windows Terminal 和命令提示符、PowerShell 用 Ctrl+Shift+V；Git Bash、PuTTY、ConEmu、Firefox 等用 Shift+Insert。选择「Shift+Insert」则所有应用都固定用 Shift+Insert。从旧版升级时，原来的默认设置会自动改为「自动」，使用习惯不变。
- **WPS**：收录带格式内容时不再读取链接类格式，避免个别情况下 WPS 崩溃。
- **托盘图标**：设为隐藏后，解锁电脑、远程桌面重连或资源管理器重启时会自动重新隐藏（可能短暂闪现）。
- **Esc**：关闭「方向键选择」后，Esc 依然可以关闭窗口。
- **从 Ditto 导入**历史记录（分组变为标签，快速粘贴文字变为备注）。
- **贴边收纳**：窗口弹出和收起时不再抢走其他软件的输入焦点；贴边收着时退出，下次启动后快捷键可以直接呼出窗口。

## 新功能

**界面**
- **双栏布局**：窗口宽度达到 550 像素后（「双栏预览」，默认开启），左边是记录列表，右边是详情，可以查看文字、表格、图片和文件，常用操作也都在详情里。设置页同样改成左右两栏，中间的分隔线可以拖动；复制规则、标签管理原本就是两栏，这次统一了样式。
- **全新设置页**：按「基础 / 剪贴板 / 同步与传输 / 数据与安全」分组；新安装的默认值重新调整过，老用户升级后保留原来的设置。
- **主题**：新增终端、票据、水墨主题；原来的毛玻璃、纸质书感、3D复古、便利贴改名为磨砂、纸张、复古、便签。「系统」主题可选配色：薄荷、薰衣草、暖橙、樱花（原樱花主题并入这里），也可以自己选颜色。所有内置主题的文字对比度都经过检查。
- **新图标和新音效**。
- **快捷键录制**：只有 Shift 或单个按键的组合会被拒绝，避免吞掉正常输入；macOS 可以录制带 Option 的快捷键。

**剪贴板**
- **贴图**：把图片钉在桌面上，滚轮缩放，Shift+滚轮调透明度。
- **备注**：每条记录都可以写备注。
- **更好的预览**：表格保留原来的颜色、边框和字体；视频显示封面（由系统生成）。在双栏详情里可以直接查看 Markdown、代码等文本文件的内容（显示原文，最多 100 KB），多个文件时可以选择预览哪一个。
- **标签更好用**：输入时列出已有标

## [4.29.1] - 2026-10-17

### 新增

- 网页搜索：“网页搜索” 能力新增 [SerpApi 搜索服务](https://serpapi.com/) (Google 网页搜索、图片搜索、学术搜索、财经搜索)、[DeepSeek 搜索服务](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/guides/search/)（网页搜索、网页内容提取）。 (#10599)
- 插件开发：为插件的单选/多选配置项（list 类型）添加本地化的 `subtitles` 副标题元数据。


### 修复

- ‼️ 电脑使用：修复部分环境（如 Docker 容器环境）下，本地隔离不可用时，无法保存 Local 权限的问题。(#10584)
- 电脑使用：恢复 Windows 下工作区范围内的文件读取、写入和编辑，通过原生文件句柄检查拒绝重解析点和硬链接别名。 (#10584)
- Core：修复开启 “会话隔离” 功能后可能造成的内存泄漏。在注册消息处理流水线之前完成群聊会话隔离，确保运行中的任务及停止请求使用正确的会话。 (#10581)
- Telegram：转换消息时保留隐藏链接。 (#10557)
- Discord：修复全体成员提及。 (#10563)
- WebUI：修复移动端点击插件视图信息后浮层立即关闭的问题。 (#10562)
- Edge TTS：保留原生客户端的 User-Agent，避免请求失败。 (#10588)
- Skills：跳过无法读取的本地及插件技能目录，避免单个目录异常导致整轮 Agent 请求失败。 (#10591)

### Added

- Web Search: Added SerpApi (Google Search, Google Image Search, Google Scholar Search and Google Finance Search) and DeepSeek Search API (web search and page content extraction). (#10599)
- Plugin development: Added localized subtitle metadata for single-select/multi-select configuration options (of type 'list') in plugins.

### Fixed

- ‼️ Computer Use: Restored workspace-scoped file reading, writing, and editing on Windows. Native handle checks reject reparse points and hardlink aliases. (#10584)
- Computer Use: Fixed saving Local permissions when isolation is unavailable. File access remains configurable; execution requiring unavailable isolation is blocked at tool execution. Defaults now give members workspace file access without execution, and administrators entire-environment execution with networking. Legacy Windows member policies with all access disabled migrate once to workspace file access, including identical manually disabled policies because their origin was not stored; later choices remain unchanged. name: oh-my-openagent
body:
**The omo-senpi typecheck gives the same result wherever the checkout sits.** It used to pick up `@types/node` from folders above the checkout, so a stray older copy there failed the typecheck while CI passed on the same commit. omo-senpi now declares its own `@types/node` and `bun-types` and reads type packages only from its own `node_modules`. ([#10320](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10320), [#10332](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10332))

**Memory items sync without losing concurrent edits, even from a stale device.** The sync item model captures a device's edits against the exact snapshot it saw, so a stale capture merges as a concurrent edit instead of silently dropping work or throwing; two captures from one device on one baseline lose nothing, multiline and quoted frontmatter values render as valid YAML on every replica, and path keys that would split one file into several (empty segments, trailing slashes, backslashes, drive letters) are rejected instead of canonicalized. Nothing syncs to a server yet. ([#10203](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10203))

**A `categories` entry named after an agent now gets a warning instead of being silently ignored.** A `task(subagent_type: "plan-consultant")` spawn reads only `agents."plan-consultant"`, so a model chain put under `categories."plan-consultant"` never reached it and the spawn ran the builtin chain, while `omo doctor` still counted that category as usable. Whenever a `categories.<name>` key equals a builtin agent or an agent in your `agents` config, and that agent does not already set its own models, the startup notice and `omo doctor` now say that key is not read for that spawn and show the corrected snippet with your own chain, for example `"agents": { "plan-consultant": { "models": [...] } }`; `agents.<name>.models` stays the one way to set an agent's models. Resolution is unchanged. Thanks to @Bearmancer for the report. ([#10323](https://git

body:
MXC SDK v1.0.1 is the first patch for MXC. The stable schema version remains `1.0.0`. 

- Crates.io: https://crates.io/crates/mxc-sdk/1.0.1
- NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@microsoft/mxc-sdk/v/1.0.1
- Nuget: [NuGet Gallery | Microsoft.Mxc.Sdk 1.0.1](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.Mxc.Sdk/1.0.1)

See the `Assets` section for `mxc-release-binaries.zip`, which contains signed binaries that can be useful for testing.

## What's Changed

### Behavior changes

- **ProcessContainer:** BaseContainer can reach host services over loopback on PSEC 1.0 hosts when `hostLoopback: "allow"` and the egress policy permit it.
- **ProcessContainer:** `captureDenials` uses option-aware Learning Mode traces where available, and verbose diagnostics include COM activation details.
- **WSLC:** a create-and-run request that combines `wslc.portMappings` with an omitted or all-`deny` `network` block is now rejected during validation. These requests previously failed at container creation.
- **WSLC:** The lifecycle daemon runs executions for up to eight containers concurrently. A second execution against a busy container is refused as `busy`.

### Bug fixes

- **ProcessContainer:** `captureDenials` now reports WFP network denials that were previously dropped because of an outdated provider GUID.
- **WSLC:** Create-and-run execution no longer fails with `HRESULT 0x80070020` while a lifecycle container is provisioned.
- **WSLC:** Create-and-run requests that omit `containerId` no longer fail with `WSLC_E_INVALID_SESSION_NAME`.
- **WSLC:** Lifecycle operations on one container no longer wait behind an execution running in another container.
- **WSLC:** a lifecycle daemon still running from an older install is rejected instead of silently ignoring new fields.
- **Bubblewrap:** DNS resolution works on hosts that use a loopback stub resolver, such as `systemd-resolved`, `dnsmasq`, or Pi-hole.
- **Bubblewrap:** Fixed an intermittent loopback setup failure at san

name: desktop
body:
# Zen Stable Release


## Security
- https://www.mozilla.org/security/advisories/mfsa2026-106

## New Features
- Updated Firefox to 158.0
- Added a `--space <id|name>` option to the command line interface.
- Library will now show a 'Open in Folder' option and download speed when hovering over the toolbar icon.
- Zen now creates more accessible PDFs when saving a page as PDF, and when printing on Linux and macOS. This also fixes a variety of PDF rendering issues, such as missing math symbols.

## Fixes
- Fixed various animation, urlbar and UI performance issues.
- Fixed Library media tab requesting onedrive to download all files from cloud. ([#15888](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/15888))
- Fixed unwanted label next to the search icon in urlbar. ([#14856](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/14856))
- Fixed Avahi access so CUPS printers are listed in flatpak sandbox. ([#9651](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/9651))
- Fixed various memory leak issues. ([#15954](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/15954))
- Fixed a crash that could occur while Zen loaded website icons (favicons).
- Fixed menus such as List all tabs, Settings, etc being hard to read with a Windows High Contrast theme. Menu background and text colors now follow the Background and Text colors chosen for a custom contrast theme in Windows Settings.
- Other bug fixes and improvements.

## Changes
- Space routing regex will now match URLs as case-insensitive.
- Library's widget hover list will now only display recently downloaded files.
- Zen no longer rounds scroll positions to whole screen pixels. Scrolling is now smoother and more precise, especially on high-resolution displays or when a page is zoomed.

body:
# v3.0.4

Maintenance and DSH 0.2.1-alpha.5 compatibility-qualification release. No routing-runtime, schema, public-API, or minimum supported Host change.

## Upstream qualification
- Exact upstream DSH 0.2.1-alpha.5 SHA: `1517a4dbca0a2789ff1d41ba439600f8547d23fa`.
- PR #713 passed Windows/macOS/Linux exact-source and Host-Sharp, Node 22/24, Windows/macOS Desktop, real `dsh web` + Chromium cold Vision, mixed attachments, Settings mount/save/reload/readback, bundle recomposition, service injection, and adversarial/legacy Host contracts.
- Published Host window stays `>=0.1.5-rc.1 <0.2.0-0 || >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`.

## Supply-chain upkeep
Consolidates upstream Action pin upgrades from #705–#709: setup-node 7.1.0, upload-artifact 7.0.2, Scorecard 2.5.0, CodeQL upload-sarif 4.38.3 and HOL scanner Action 1.2.786. The exact release-package evidence test is updated along with upload-artifact's pinned version; immutable tarball identity, trusted OIDC and provenance remain required.

## RC1 scope and outstanding issues
DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 has not yet been independently validated: semver admission is not proof of real-Host compatibility. After official release, record exact upstream tag/commit and rerun the full cross-platform source/Host/Chromium/Settings/attachment gate before claiming verified RC1 support.

Issues #684 (historical intermittent Windows alpha2 Vision pointer loss), #703 (DSH Plugin Hub Windows package.json.lock writer contention) and #704 (billion-context coexistence requiring reproduction) remain tracked; none is represented as resolved by this maintenance-only package.

No user configuration or data migration is required. Publication is a separate gated trusted-release workflow and is not performed by this preparation PR.

## Commits

- chore(release): prepare v3.0.4 and consolidate CI action updates (#714)
- test(compat): qualify DSH 0.2.1-alpha.5 exact Host and Web lifecycle (#713)
- docs: keep README release badge current for HOL launch (#712)

- 修复 Android Studio 未继承 Rust 工具路径时无法打包的问题，支持自动定位已安装工具和自定义 Cargo 路径。

- 补全附近设备同步的文件夹、根目录附件与独立标签，保留附件身份、扩展数据和来源归属；附件校验失败或不支持文件夹删除时保留受影响的数据并说明原因。

- 修复冷启动或绑定验证器查询超时时，自动填充后偶尔不显示验证码通知的问题；密码填充仍优先完成。

- 修复浏览器访问本机自托管网页时无法匹配已保存凭据的问题，保留应用内嵌页面的兼容行为。

- 升级注册、改密和分步登录的自动填充：已保存密码不会覆盖新密码框，生成密码仅填入新密码与确认框；保存时优先使用新密码，并可确认更新匹配的原条目，保留文件夹、备注、附件和其他账户。

- 无障碍补充填充同样避开新密码与确认框，并校验动态网页的密码写入结果以便必要时重试；再次锁定时立即关闭单独验证过的自动填充保存页。

- 改进验证返回与连续登录，限制临时上下文的来源和有效期；增加可取消的请求时限、缓存失效处理和不含凭据的分阶段耗时诊断。

- 改进自动填充的网页识别：支持浏览器标准化提示，准确区分账号、当前密码、新密码和验证码；网页提供表单结构时仅填充当前表单，保留原生应用和旧网页的兼容逻辑。

- 优化原始数据库管理：名称最多显示两行、双栏独立滚动，支持滑动区间多选、长按菜单，以及跟随当前聚焦栏的底部操作与前进／后退导航；修复普通 MDBX 条目跨格式传输被误拦截。

- 新增 Bitwarden Authenticator CSV 导入，独立入口简称“Bitwarden Auth.”，保留验证器账户及验证码参数。

name: Mole
body:
Mole

Deep clean and optimize your Mac.

### Changelog 1. **Select all personal data with one key**: In the personal data list `mo uninstall` opens with D, pressing A selects every path and pressing it again clears them, so removing all of an app's data takes two keys while you still see each path before confirming. 2. **Work with GNU tools first in PATH**: Mole now calls the macOS versions of stat, find, tr, date and du directly, so Homebrew coreutils, findutils or grep earlier in PATH no longer stop `mo clean` with an unbound variable, skip cloud folders, break name search for apps like Écrivain, or fail sizes in Analyze. 3. **Keep game libraries, rollbacks and live system data**: Uninstall never offers the Steam folder that holds your games, Nix cleanup removes only store paths nothing references and keeps your profile generations, and clean leaves every live power log database alone. 4. **Clean old browser builds and device symbols**: Clean removes Chrome builds agent-browser no longer launches, keeping the one it uses or that you pinned, and prunes old macOS and visionOS DeviceSupport versions like the other platforms. 5. **No Xcode install prompt during clean**: Clean leaves the simulator tools alone until Xcode has finished its own first-launch setup, so skipping the admin prompt no longer leads to a system password dialog, and simulator checks show a spinner instead of looking stuck. 6. **Log every change Mole makes**: Dry runs, refused removals, Analyze moves to Trash, Homebrew, launch and login item changes, and package manager cleanups now each leave a row in the operation log, and `mo remove` keeps those logs. 7. **Search and list apps faster**: `mo uninstall ` with hundreds of apps returns in well under a second, and `mo uninstall --list` reads Home

### Highlights

name: iPhoneMirror
body:
这是用于功能和兼容性测试的预览版。

### 新增与改进

- 支持同时录制和直播，可分别停止输出；直播期间可保存或丢弃已完成录制。
- 安装包与便携版内置固定版本的 Personalized DDI 和 iOS 27 Cryptex DDI，使用前校验载荷；Apple 个性化签名仍需联网。
- 设置助手增加工具入口，改进设备绑定、开发者模式引导和错误提示。
- 合并设置助手中的 USB、AirPlay 和蓝牙绑定步骤，打开设备绑定器时自动启动 AirPlay 接收，并支持失败重试。
- 改进 Automation API 的远程文本输入、会话管理、并行输出和启动取消处理。

### 修复

- 改进新设备 USB 描述符与活动配置等待，修正部分设备的显示尺寸映射。
- 改进 Apple USBMux 就绪检测，支持探测商店版 Apple Devices，并提供端口占用诊断。
- 修复 Cryptex/DDI 准备阶段的连接释放、取消和超时处理，打包并校验所需运行时能力。
- 修复预览重绘、键盘焦点、设备切换和媒体输出状态处理问题。
- 修复设备绑定器周期刷新时右侧动画重复播放导致的闪烁。
- 修复 SRS 测试服务的 HTTP 错误处理及多语言资源格式问题。
- 应用与驱动管理器版本统一为 1.8.5-pre3。

### 验证范围

自动构建执行原生、Python、应用逻辑、驱动及本地化检查。GitHub 托管环境不运行需要交互桌面的 WPF 运行时测试。
目标设备上的 Apple 签名、DDI 安装与控制兼容性，以及最终 ZIP/Setup 的完整安装、升级、卸载和实机验收仍需验证；构建通过不代表这些场景已通过。

### Added

- Record and stream simultaneously, stop each output independently, and save or discard a completed recording while streaming continues.
- Bundle pinned Personalized and iOS 27 Cryptex DDI assets in both Setup and portable ZIP builds; Apple personalization still requires network access.
- Add setup tool entry points and improve device binding, developer mode guidance, and error messages.
- Combine USB, AirPlay, and Bluetooth setup into one binding step, start AirPlay reception when the binder opens, and allow retry after startup failure.
- Improve Automation API remote text input, session management, parallel output, and startup cancellation.

### Fixed

- Improve USB descriptor and active configuration readiness checks and correct display size mappings for selected devices.

name: UniGetUI
body:
# Devolutions UniGetUI 2026.3.2

This release adds an experimental Software Catalog and Catalog Editor (turned on in Settings > Experimental), lets you reorder the sidebar pages by drag and drop, brings macOS's new Liquid Glass look to UniGetUI on Mac, and fixes a set of crashes and package manager bugs.

### New Features
* Added an experimental Software Catalog and Catalog Editor, turned on in Settings > Experimental. The catalog is a page of approved software that users can install, update and uninstall in one click. Administrators build it with the Catalog Editor: they can manage several catalogs, pin package versions, and add packages straight from Discover.
* You can now reorder the sidebar pages by drag and drop, or with Alt+Up/Down. Keyboard shortcuts follow the new order, and you can reset it in Settings > User interface.
* UniGetUI on Mac now uses macOS's new Liquid Glass look.

### Improvements
* The package list now keeps its scroll position when an operation finishes, instead of jumping back to the top.
* Package details and "Download installer" now pick the same WinGet installer as installs and updates, following your scope and architecture settings.
* Screen readers now announce the real names of expanders and package list cells instead of control type names.

### Bug Fixes
* Fixed Pip updates that could corrupt the Python environment. Pip operations now run one at a time.
* Fixed PowerShell 7 modules installed for all users that couldn't be uninstalled.
* Fixed Chocolatey packages, such as Python, that need administrator rights not being retried as administrator.
* Fixed several crashes, including at startup, with unreadable icon files, and with screen readers.
* Fixed the restart prompt showing when opening Experimental settings without changing anything.
* Fixed a duplicated top bar and a crash in the terminal UI.

Thank you to everyone who reported issues and contributed improvements to the project.

name: RTX40MFG-Unlock
body:
**V1.5.0-hotfix.1 fixes a VRAM leak when Frame Generation is switched on again.** In The Witcher 3 each switch kept about 425 MiB of video memory until the game was closed. Thanks to Thalixte for the fix ([#80](https://github.com/dashdogy/MFG-Unlocker/pull/80)).

Nothing else changes from V1.5.0. To update, close the game and replace the installed `MFGUnlocker.dll` (or `MFGUnlocker.asi` in `OptiScaler\plugins`) with the new one, keeping its filename. Your settings carry over.

The ZIP contains only **MFGUnlocker.dll**. Press **Backspace** to open the menu (without OptiScaler). See the [README](https://github.com/dashdogy/MFG-Unlocker/blob/v1.5.0-hotfix.1/README.md) for installation, supported filenames and OptiScaler setup. SHA-256 checksums for the ZIP and the extracted DLL are attached.

**Licence note:** `MFGUnlocker.dll` embeds XeSS Frame Generation program data derived from Intel's XeSS SDK. That data is Intel's work, is not covered by the MIT License, and remains subject to Intel's licence terms. See [NOTICE.md](https://github.com/dashdogy/MFG-Unlocker/blob/v1.5.0-hotfix.1/NOTICE.md).

The hotfix DLL passed all 67 local release regression cases (2,455 assertions) and the DLSS Frame Generation 310.9.16 admission checks for RTX 40 and RTX 30. The leak fix was confirmed in The Witcher 3 by its author; an in-game check with this exact DLL is still pending.

body:
> [!NOTE]
> This release fixes backup handling across older Docker daemons and S3, improves health and scheduler reliability, and reduces live-stats rendering costs.

### Backups and storage
- Bind-mount volume subpaths when backing up on daemons older than API 1.45. (#4399) @kmendell
- Send S3 request checksums only when required, improving GCS compatibility. (#4401) @kmendell
- Write S3-only system backups directly to S3 without a local repository. (#4400) @kmendell
- Include the absolute path and UID in project-directory permission errors. (#4404) @kmendell

### Containers, projects, and scheduling
- Report Francis as down when its host exits and extend its health-check deadline. (#4402) @kmendell
- Exclude Swarm task containers from the standalone-container filter. (#4405) @kmendell
- Preserve build image references when Compose fails to load, and document the update-check label. (#4406) @kmendell
- Reset invalid cron settings to defaults at startup. (#4425) @kmendell
- Clear caches when refreshing a workspace. (#4427) @kmendell
- Allow manual updates for services with the updater disabled. (#4430) @kmendell

### Registries, updates, and access
- Retry digest lookups after TLS handshake timeouts. (#4428) @kmendell
- Remove the stale digest name left behind when a frozen pull is tagged. (#4409) @kmendell
- Stop resending image-update push notifications on every poll. (`cd7c39cfcb6c364751d4b55bab887c11b5ebd859`) @kmendell
- Restrict SSH host-key algorithms to entries in `known_hosts`. (#4403) @kmendell
- Match user email lookups without regard to case. (#4429) @kmendell

### Interface and performance
- Fix virtualized table cells being clipped by locking column widths in pixels. (#4407) @kmendell
- Localize settings backup cards and role presets, and prevent long labels from overflowing. (#4408) @kmendell
- Batch live stats by environment to reduce table rendering costs. (`3330f4e0f53bb152cc4720be8ae724cdb1bd8cbb`) @kmendell

name: alt-sendme
body:
### Security

**Please update.** This release fixes a security issue in `iroh-blobs` (updated to 0.103.1). A bug in the provider's event mask meant push requests were accepted even though they were meant to be disabled by default. Any peer able to connect to a provider could write data into its store. The data is content-addressed and verified, so existing blobs could not be modified, but a peer could fill up disk space.

Versions 0.94.0 through 0.103.0 of `iroh-blobs` are affected. Details: https://www.iroh.computer/blog/iroh-blobs-push-fix

### Highlights

- **Security:** Update `iroh-blobs` to 0.103.1 (fixes the push request issue above)
- **Dependencies:** Update `iroh` to 1.3.0 and `rustls` to 0.23.45
- **I18n:** Use the OS language by default

### Bug fixes

- **Tray:** Show the tray icon on Linux by attaching its menu (#329)
- **I18n:** Follow the OS language when it changes and match full language codes
- **I18n:** Keep locale detection working when storage is unavailable
- **Docs:** Update the Vercel program logo to support dark and light themes

### Improvements

- **Docs:** Simplify the HTML structure of sponsor logos in multiple language READMEs

### Dependency updates

- Update `iroh-blobs` to 0.103.1 (#332)
- Update `iroh` to 1.3.0 and `rustls` to 0.23.45 (#333)

* The default ALAC decoder is now from the [FFmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org) library. The Hammerton decoder is no longer the default ALAC decoder for Classic AirPlay builds; it remains an option but is strongly deprecated for security reasons.
* A number of memory allocation and out-of-bounds issues have been identified and dealt with. name: DeskBox
body:
DeskBox 1.5.8 keeps DeskBox and Explorer at the same integrity level, and explains accurately when they can't be. Fully elevated desktops — company-managed machines included — no longer see the administrator notice, because drag and drop works there. When the notice does appear, it closes the elevated instance in one click and provides the steps to restart with normal privileges, including how to clear a shortcut's "Run as administrator" checkbox. One-click updates restart the app at the shell's own level, so an elevated machine no longer comes back as administrator after updating. When Explorer itself runs elevated, the app stays usable — the reveal hotkey and settings keep working — and diagnostics can now detect a shortcut-level "Run as administrator" flag.

The maintenance wave lands with it: Todo-widget drags no longer crash; switching groups no longer loses stacked-member icons; cutting a subfolder and pasting it into its parent no longer hangs; auto-organization rules stay enabled across restarts; a repeatedly crashing desktop no longer leaves DeskBox restarting in a loop at sign-in; an update-download failure no longer errors when another dialog is open; and an instance relaunched with normal privileges can be ended by Task Manager without elevation.

## Released

- **Date:** 2026-10-14
- **Version:** 1.5.8
- **Tag:** `v1.5.8`

## Highlights

- **More accurate administrator notices.** The notice now appears only when DeskBox runs above the shell. When it appears, one click exits the elevated instance and the notice walks through restarting with normal privileges — including how to clear a shortcut's "Run as administrator" checkbox. Autostart continues to restart silently with normal privileges. All 12 languages.
- **Updates keep the shell's level.** The updater restarts the app at Explorer's own privilege level whenever the shell offers a standard-user context, so machines that ran elevated no longer relaunch as administrator after a one-click update.

body:
## v4.11.0

`4.11.0` 收录 `v4.10.10` 之后的主线改动（约 180 个提交）。其中有**两项不兼容变更**（缓存维护接口、Notion OAuth 授权入口），升级前请先阅读下面的「升级须知」；其余普通站点同步最新 `main` 后重新部署即可。

### 升级须知（请先阅读）

1. **缓存维护接口需要令牌（不兼容）**：`/api/cache` 必须配置 `CACHE_REVALIDATION_TOKEN` 并携带 `Authorization: Bearer <令牌>`；未配置时返回 HTTP 503，不再允许无令牌清理缓存。已有的维护脚本需补充环境变量和请求头。详见 [数据缓存与页面重建](https://github.com/notionnext-org/NotionNext/blob/main/docs/developer/CACHE_MAINTENANCE.zh-CN.md)。
2. **Notion OAuth 授权入口变更（不兼容）**：升级后必须从本站 `/api/auth/notion` 发起授权；旧的直接携带 code 访问回调的方式不再接受。详见 [Notion OAuth 授权入口](https://github.com/notionnext-org/NotionNext/blob/main/docs/developer/NOTION_OAUTH.zh-CN.md)。
3. **Notion 图片**：新版 Notion 接口返回的 `file.notion.com` 图片链接已适配图片反代和签名刷新，之前为解决图片过期而临时设置 `API_BASE_URL=https://www.notion.so/api/v3` 的站点，升级后不再需要该设置。外链（http/https）图片现在也会经 `NEXT_PUBLIC_NOTION_HOST` 的图片中转端点加载，使用自定义反代地址的站点请确认中转端可用。
4. **字体**：默认不再加载 `Noto Sans SC`、`Noto Serif SC` 等第三方中文 Web Font，未配置自定义字体的站点会改用系统字体，外观会有变化。需要品牌字体请显式配置 `NEXT_PUBLIC_FONT_URL`（或 Notion Config 的 `FONT_URL`）。
5. **非本站工作区的页面会返回 404**：通过页面 id 兜底渲染时会校验页面是否属于本站 Notion 工作区，工作区 id 默认自动推导，也可用 `NOTION_WORKSPACE_ID` 指定（多站点用逗号分隔）。见 [NOTION_WORKSPACE_ID](https://notionnext.tangly1024.com/user-guide/config/notion-workspace-id)。
6. **访问统计默认端点**：不蒜子默认脚本已切换为社区维护的 Vercount（`https://events.vercount.one/js`），可用 `NEXT_PUBLIC_BUSUANZI_SCRIPT_URL` 覆盖。见 [不蒜子统计](https://notionnext.tangly1024.com/user-guide/analytics/busuanzi)。

### 图片与 Notion 数据

- 恢复 `NEXT_PUBLIC_NOTION_HOST` 图片反代与签名刷新，适配 `file.notion.com` 新图片 CDN（#4476、#4473）。
- 外链图片经图片中转端点加载，避免防盗链图床拒绝带本站 Referer 的请求；反代图片支持高清缩放与随机图替换。
- 数据库的 Created time / Last edited time 系统属性不再丢失；嵌套 Gallery 视图设置、Gallery 单列显示问题已修复。
- 内嵌页面链接解析会先去掉 query 与 hash 再提取页面 ID。

使用方法见 [Notion 图片反代与缓存](https://notionnext.tangly1024.com/user-guide/deploy/notion-image-proxy)。

### 安全与接口

- `/api/revalidate` 的单页请求默认只重建指定页；清理数据须显式传入 `invalidateData: true`，全站请求使用 `all: true`。批量重建默认每次最多 25 页，HTTP 202 返回剩余路径供调用方续传。多实例或 Serverless 部署要实现同步失效，必须配置所有实例共用的 Redis。
- Notion OAuth 改为服务端授权流程：授权结果不再携带

name: fastfetch
body:
Changes:
* LocalIP flags on Windows now describe the interface itself — its operational status, its media connection state and its type, for example `ETHERNET_CSMACD`, `IEEE80211` or `SOFTWARE_LOOPBACK` — instead of the `IP_ADAPTER_*` bits.
    * Interfaces that carry no unicast address are no longer reported, since both the addresses and the interface properties are now enumerated from the unicast address table. (LocalIP, Windows)
* libpulse and libddcutil are no longer used on Linux. Package managers should remove them from their fastfetch package.
* QuickJS format scripting has been removed (deprecated in v2.69.0). Migrate scripts to Lua if necessary. (General)
* The Command module option `useStdErr` has been replaced with `useOutput`, which selects which of the command's output streams to capture: `"stdout"`, `"stderr"` or `"both"`.
    * It defaults to `"both"`, so a command that logs to stderr now has that output captured instead of discarded.
    * Set it to `"stdout"` or `"stderr"` to restore the old single-stream behavior. (Command)
* The Shell module now reports the shell from the password database (`/etc/passwd`) instead of the `$SHELL` environment variable, which may differ when the login shell was changed after the session started. (Title)
* The Disk custom format no longer provides `{size-available}`. `{size-free}` now reports whichever of the two the `disk.useAvailable` option selects, and the raw byte counts are available as `{bytes-used}` and `{bytes-total}`. (Disk)
    * This also means `{size-free}` now changes with `disk.useAvailable`; it used to always report the file system's free size.
* The Disk JSON output no longer includes `bytes.available` and `bytes.used`. (Disk)
    * `bytes.free` and `bytes.total` are unchanged; the used size can be derived as `total - free`.

name: Magpie
body:
# Magpie Experimental v0.6.10

本版汇总 0.6.9 之后的更新：重新整理帧率与刷新设置，加入 RTSS 联动、实验性 VRR 和 FSR 3 补帧，更新 NVIDIA VFX、HDR 手动效果链及窗口兼容性。

## 功能更新

### Magpie 本体易用性更新

#### 帧率与刷新

- 新增全局记忆的 **简单／高级** 模式，默认简单。简单模式集中显示内容帧率、静态画面重绘和 VRR；高级模式提供节奏、光标与重复帧检测等详细选项。切换时保留高级偏好。
- 内容帧率使用 **跟随源／自定义**，旧内容“自动”设置迁移为跟随源。手动内容、光标和空闲帧率均为 **15–360 FPS，整数，步进 1**。新配置默认内容 60 FPS、空闲重绘开启且为 30 FPS；已有有效数值保留。
- 简单模式使用 Front Edge 节奏与原始帧优先的光标补充刷新；高级模式保留 Front Edge／Async／NVIDIA Reflex 与光标策略选择。修改在重新开始缩放后生效，运行中可使用“保存并重启”。
- 统一模式与数值输入的排列、独立单位和窄窗口换行；简单模式“恢复默认”恢复可见设置并保留隐藏的高级偏好。

#### RTSS 目标应用限帧

- 新增 **RTSS 配置接管**，默认关闭，可管理全局或目标应用配置。开启联动后，缩放开始时自动准备已安装的 RTSS 与 Magpie 自身配置，再应用目标限帧。MSI Afterburner 为可选工具。
- 支持同步 Magpie 的基础内容目标，或指定 **15–360 FPS、步进 1** 的上限；同步目标可在 1–1000 FPS 内解析。跟随源时不使用同步限帧，保存的偏好保留。补帧输出帧率与源应用限帧分别处理。
- 提供工具状态、只读重新检测、初始化和当前会话重试。RTSS 异常显示具体原因，正常缩放可继续。默认正常结束时尝试恢复原限帧，也可选择保留修改；外部配置冲突时停止覆盖。
- 崩溃或强制结束可能保留最后写入值。“已写入”表示配置核对通过，游戏实际限帧仍取决于 RTSS 挂钩和运行状态。新配置与尚未迁移的设置默认请求管理员启动，之后保留用户关闭该选项的选择。

#### VRR、截图与引导

- 增加默认关闭的 **可变刷新率（实验）**。开启后重新开始缩放，按呈现路径、显卡和显示器能力请求 VRR。
- 截图可选择 **原始输入＋最终输出、仅输出（默认）、仅输入**，成对截图使用同一真实内容帧。保留效果／通道 PNG 与 DDS 导出，HDR PNG 转为 SDR sRGB，DDS 保留实际格式。
- 重写 **165 个内置效果器**的中英文说明与参数提示，优先说明用途、适合素材和起步方法，完整组合限制集中到使用指南。
- DLSSNR 增加持续状态和分类恢复引导，区分启动中、运行中、单层跳过和多层停止。

### 效果器更新

#### FSR 3 补帧（实验）

- 新增 **FSR3 FrameGeneration**，固定 **2×**、仅支持 **SDR**，可与超分配合或单独使用。一条链使用一个补帧效果。
- 必须使用外部光流，默认 **AMDOF／质量**，也可选择 NVOF。旧缺省或“无”选择迁移为 AMDOF 质量，已有合法选择保留。
- 支持 NIS／NVSharpen 等已列明的矩形组合及输出内部黑边。不支持 HDR、CRT、几何变形、超出输出的裁剪和清单外效果，详见 `FSR3FG-README.md`。
- 支持静止画面的实时参数更新，修改生效后刷新当前画面。

#### NVIDIA VFX 与 HDR

- 更新为匹配的 NVIDIA VFX 1.3.0.0 组件，整合 **Upscale、VSR、VFG、TrueHDR**。
- Upscale 支持原生放大与最终尺寸适配，锐度 **0–1，默认 0.4，步进 0.01**。VSR 提供 Standard／High bitrate／Streaming／Denoise／Deblur 分类，默认 Standard、Medium，兼容已有降噪配置。
- VFG 支持 SDR **2–8×，默认 2×，步进 1**；模型为 Performance／Balanced，默认 Balanced，旧 High 迁移为 Balanced。自动场景切换检测默认开启，关闭后不使用该自动检测。
- TrueHDR 默认开启去色带，关闭时不使用去色带处理；保留精确输入与实时更新。对比度／饱和度 **0–200、默认 100**，中间灰 **10–100、默认 50**，峰值亮度 **

name: fish-speech
body:
# Fish Audio Drama 3 — Pre-Release

> An open-source speech generation model that turns text into directed performances.

Pre-trained on **several hundred billion tokens** across **~80 languages and dialects**, Drama 3 combines a **35B-A3B hybrid linear-attention MoE backbone** (initialized from Qwen3.5) with a new **codebook-MTP audio decoder** and **RL from a single human-preference reward model**. It clones voices from multiple references, follows natural-language direction, revises a take from a note in the next turn, voices multi-character scenes, edits speech by infilling, and synthesizes long-form and streaming audio, all in one model.

[Technical Report](https://github.com/fishaudio/fish-speech/blob/main/docs/assets/Fish_Audio_Drama_3_Technical_Report.pdf) · [Model](https://huggingface.co/fishaudio/drama-3) · [Docs](https://speech.fish.audio/) · [Playground](https://fish.audio/)

## Model

| Variant | Params | Codec | Output |
|---------|--------|-------|--------|
| Drama 3 | 35B MoE (3B active) + 13-layer codebook-MTP decoder | ModifiedDAC (same as S2), 10 codebooks, ~21.5 Hz | 44.1 kHz |

Requires an NVIDIA GPU with at least 48 GB (FP8). S2-Pro remains fully supported with the same command line, API server and WebUI; the model type is read from the checkpoint's `config.json`.

## Highlights

- **Hybrid MoE backbone**: Gated DeltaNet linear attention with one gated full-attention layer in four; 256 experts, top-8 plus a shared expert, ~3B active per token
- **Codebook-MTP decoder**: 13 layers (4 shared + 9 per-codebook) replace S2's Fast AR; each layer attends causally over the whole sequence, including the reference audio
- **Directed performance**: point tags like `[laughs]`, scoped tags like `<whisper>...</whisper>`, style descriptions and free-form director's notes
- **Multi-turn revision**: when a take misses, the next turn gives a note such as `[happier versus previous]` and the model redoes it, keeping the original reference and

name: whatcable
body:
# Devices in the right box, displays read from macOS, and live charging

A big one. Ten betas went into this, and most of what changed started with a tester's report. Credits inline.

## Connected devices

- **Devices on a Thunderbolt chain show under a dock or display only when the hardware proves they are inside it.** Before, a device could look as if it sat in the first box in the chain just because nothing said otherwise. Anything unproven now appears under "Other USB devices on this port", and a dock's own hubs nest where they belong.
- **Thunderbolt 5 daisy chains are sorted.** On a Mac to display to dock chain, a drive in the dock used to render under the display. WhatCable now works out which box each hub belongs to from the fabric's own routing data, and leaves the tree alone if the answer does not check out.
- **Devices behind TB3-era docks and displays are attributed to a port again.** LG UltraFine 5K, CalDigit TS3+ and others of that generation bring their own USB controller, and everything behind them used to vanish as soon as two Thunderbolt things were connected.
- **Built-in USB-A ports are labelled and split per physical port** (#490, thanks @i0ntempest). The box now says to move those devices to a Thunderbolt port to see more about them.
- **A port that can't read cable details now says where to plug the cable instead:** a Thunderbolt port (#436, thanks @apple-ihack-geek).

## Displays

- The display check now reads what macOS says the display is doing, instead of estimating from bandwidth. It tells "the cable is limiting your monitor" apart from "your monitor is set below its best mode".
- Fewer false warnings on TVs and HDMI adapters: modes they can only send in reduced colour (4:2:0) no longer count against the cable.
- Every mode the display declares is read, including DisplayID blocks that were skipped before. Where macOS doesn't say enough, the card reads "Display connected" with the reason, rather than a guessed all-clear.

> Pre-release for testing. Report issues: https://github.com/rokartur/BetterAudio/issues
> Get betas in-app: Settings → General → Include beta versions.

### Since beta.2

### Added
- Ignore an app from its row: BetterAudio leaves its audio untouched, and the row moves to a collapsed Ignored group. Also `betteraudio app ignore` and Shortcuts. #150
- Per-app volume goes up to 400%, with the boost picked in the app row's settings. #149
- Settings → Per-app Volume → Volume for new apps sets the level an app gets the first time it plays. #154
- Shortcuts for the app that plays now: volume up, volume down and mute, with a HUD that shows the app. Set the keys in Settings → Per-app Volume → Shortcuts. #151
- Keyboard control of the menu panel: arrow keys move between rows and change volume, M mutes, Return picks a device, `/` filters by name. #152
- Save an EQ curve as a named preset from the "..." button next to the preset menu. Presets sync over iCloud and work in Shortcuts and `betteraudio app eq set`. #153
- Right-click the menu bar icon for mute, device lists, audio profiles, Preferences and Quit. #163
- Settings → General → Appearance: System, Light or Dark. #164
- Settings → General → HUD behavior turns off all BetterAudio HUDs or each HUD on its own. Also `betteraudio hud`. #162
- Tooltips and VoiceOver labels on the icon buttons in the menu panel, for example "Mute Spotify". #161
- A short tour of per-app volume, routing and shortcuts after onboarding. Settings → About → Show Feature Tour shows it again. #161

- Settings → General → Menu width offers Compact, Standard, Wide and Custom. Standard is 360 pt instead of 320 pt, and the wide layout is free. #160

name: WWPlayer
body:
##新功能
- 新增简体中文、繁体中文和英文界面，元数据语言可独立设置。
- 新增未加密蓝光 ISO 原盘播放支持。
- 新增主／副双字幕，可分别选择、关闭、调整样式与同步偏移，支持跟随主字幕或独立定位。
- 本地视频支持自动匹配视频同名文件夹内的外挂字幕。
- 在线字幕支持中文、英文、日文及来源筛选，提供下载进度与取消操作。
- 新增上一／下一章节快捷键，默认使用 PageUp／PageDown。
- 新增 TMDB 支持自定义资料 API、图片地址与独立连接检查。
- 新增TMDB搜索结果切换
- 新增整季弹幕匹配，支持逐集选择来源与调整偏移。
##优化
- 直播改用主播放器，完善频道分组、搜索与逐步加载，简化在线列表、本地 M3U/M3U8 文件及单个直播地址的配置。
- 优化时间轴预览，优先使用 Emby/Jellyfin 服务端缩略图，改善快速拖动时的画面更新与取消操作。
- 重整字幕选择与调整菜单。
- 加快详情页与跨服务器资源加载，减少重复查询与等待。
- 简化服务器和模块管理卡片，改善资源列表布局与长标题显示。
- 完善弹幕匹配与多格式读取，调整来源偏移时无需重新加载弹幕。
- 评分支持跳转到对应影片页面，改善 Trakt 列表的滚动体验。
- 细节优化。
##修复
- 修复长时间暂停、系统睡眠后播放恢复异常，恢复时保留暂停状态与播放进度。
- 修复部分资源起播卡住、正常缓冲被误报为失败，以及预加载和切集状态异常。
- 修复音轨／字幕切换误触发播放恢复，以及换集后轨道偏好恢复错误。
- 修复跨服务器剧集身份、播放来源错配及聚合资源漏项。
- 修复来源服务器不可用时继续观看详情无法打开，以及 Trakt 进度清除不完整的问题。
- 修复 WebDAV 媒体源恢复后缺失、凭据查看异常及部分签名地址无法播放的问题。
- 修复模块播放、预加载、外置播放器与部分补充资料请求未遵循软件代理的问题。
- 修复本地头像保存依赖云同步及重启后头像丢失的问题。
- 修复主窗口最大化状态恢复、播放器键盘焦点与控制栏自动隐藏异常。
- 修复 NEXUS 分享类型识别、文件导入安装统计与分享归属异常。

name: cc-switch
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.9

### 4.0 正式版的第五个修复版本

重新梳理了添加供应商的整个流程：表单按填写顺序排列，地址和 Key 之后就是模型列表；点「获取模型列表」后弹窗自动打开，每个模型的上下文窗口、是否支持推理和图片输入都已经查好，勾选后点「应用」就连同参数一起加进列表，同一个弹窗里取消勾选就能移除；字段说明收进「?」，提示会按应用当前是直连、路由还是聚合来显示。另外修复了 Codex 新建线程和自动化在部分上游报错、整个线程无法继续的问题：经路由转成 Chat 协议的 DeepSeek、OpenCode Zen 等报 400，xAI 原生 Responses 报 422。WSL2 里的 Claude Desktop 等连不上本机回环的客户端，现在可以在「设置 → 本地路由」填一个「连接地址」。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.9-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.9-ja.md)**

---

## 重新梳理的供应商添加流程

这一版把添加和编辑供应商的表单从头到尾理了一遍，主要是 Claude Code、Codex 和聚合三种布局。以前模型列表收在高级选项里，排在它所决定的默认模型后面；获取到的模型只能在列表下方逐个添加，加完还要逐个核对自动填好的参数；几乎每个字段下面都有一段灰字，有些提示和你实际所处的模式对不上。现在按填写顺序走一遍：

**1. 地址、Key 和上游格式。** 先选预设或填地址和 Key。选上游格式时，提示按应用当前的模式显示：应用处在直连模式时，如果选的格式需要转换，格式下面会提示这张卡正在直连使用、改成这种格式保存后请求会失败，或者这种格式要先切到路由或聚合才能用。Claude Code 的上游格式选 OpenAI Chat 或 Responses 时，不再显示用不上的认证字段。

**2. 模型列表：获取、挑选、自动填参数。** Codex 的模型列表从高级选项里挪了出来，紧跟在地址和 Key 后面，和聚合布局一样叫「模型列表」。Claude Code 聚合、Codex、OpenCode 和 MiniMax Code 的模型列表现在这样添加模型：

1. 点模型列表上的「获取模型列表」。
2. 获取成功后「选择模型」弹窗自动打开。每个模型旁边已经显示好上下文窗口，以及是否支持推理和图片输入，数值来自同地址的预设，其次按供应商地址查 models.dev，再其次查模型厂商自己的条目。
3. 勾选想要的模型，点「应用」。新模型追加到列表末尾，参数按弹窗里显示的值直接填好，不再弹「已补全……的上下文等参数，请核对」的提示。

同一个弹窗也负责删除：勾选表示「在列表里」，已配置的模型默认勾选，取消勾选后点「应用」就会从列表移除，点「取消」什么都不改。留下的模型保持原来的顺序和设置。已配置但供应商这次没返回的模型，单独列在「不在供应商列表中」一组，也能一并清理。弹窗支持搜索、全选 / 全不选、只看已选，并显示已选数量；获取过一次后按钮变成「选择模型」，再点不会重新获取，需要时在弹窗里点「重新获取」。

**3. 默认模型：列表第一行。** Codex 有模型列表时，第一行就是默认模型，不再单独有一个默认模型输入框；改名或删掉第一行，默认模型跟着变。列表原本为空时，添加模型会自动把当前的默认模型放在第一行，默认模型不会因为加了列表而变掉。没有配置模型列表的卡仍然保留默认模型输入框：这类卡用的是 Codex 自带的 `/model` 菜单，加上列表后菜单里只会剩下列表里的模型。聚合模型列表也去掉了每行的 ★ 和「设为默认模型」，规则同样是第一行即默认。

**4. 子代理（Codex，新增）。** Codex 表单新增「子代理模型」和「子代理推理强度」，对应 `config.toml` 里 `[agents]` 下的 `default_subagent_model` 和 `default_subagent_reasoning_effort`。留空就删掉对应的键，子代理沿用主代理的设置；切换供应商时这两项跟着换，`[agents]` 下的其他设置不动。填的模型不在模型列表里时，表

name: moonlight-vplus
body:
## 🌙 Moonlight V+ 12.13.0

感谢你使用 Moonlight V+！如果喜欢，记得点亮一颗 ⭐～

本次更新重点加入 PyroWave Vulkan 解码与 HDR 呈现，并完善 USB、手柄、更新检查和设置页面体验。

### 新增

- ✨ 新增 PyroWave Vulkan 解码、HDR 呈现，暂不支持动态 HDR 元数据（HDR10+、Dobly）、暂不支持帧生成 (#693、#698、#713)
- ✨ 新增 PyroWave 能力检测，可查看设备 Vulkan 和 GPU 是否满足运行条件 (#694)
- ✨ 性能监控图层支持从悬浮按钮调用，并可显示时钟 (#667)
- ✨ Android 13 及以上设备支持在远程文本框获得焦点时自动弹出本地键盘 (#660)
- ✨ 王冠商店新增搜索和排序功能 (#670)
- ✨ 更新检查机制优化增加区域元数据来源和下载失败恢复机制，并校验下载文件完整性 (#687)
- ✨ 背景图片增加审核过滤 (#696)
- ✨ 横屏设置页面新增返回按钮和搜索功能，搜索结果可以定位到对应分类 (#684)
- ✨ 支持同时转发多个 USB 设备，并增加实验性的 ARMv7 USB 转发支持 (#648、#697)
- ✨ 新增客户端网络优化自适应 FEC 模式和比例设置 (#686)
- ✨ 虚拟手柄设置按钮支持拖动和位置记忆 (#702)
- ✨ 平板触摸板新增灵敏度设置 (#705)

### 优化

- ⚡ 优化王冠商店的 GitHub 授权、请求轮询和授权失效处理 (#668)
- ⚡ 优化 STUN 主机远程地址查询，减少网络异常时对主机状态的影响 (#701)

### 修复

- 🐛 虚拟键盘打开时隐藏王冠按键，关闭后恢复原状态 (#676)
- 🐛 修复新手引导中非焦点按钮需要点击两次的问题 (#678)
- 🐛 修复隐藏摇杆方向输入和快速触摸时缺少振动反馈的问题 (#681)
- 🐛 修复王冠组合按键释放顺序错误导致 Alt 快捷键异常的问题 (#685)
- 🐛 修复部分内置手柄和非标准摇杆轴无法使用震动反馈的问题 (#703)
- 🐛 修复 Android TV 启动器无法显示游戏海报的问题 (#708)

### ❤️ 感谢社区贡献

感谢所有提供设备测试、问题反馈和使用建议的社区用户，你们的反馈帮助我们把这些改进从代码变成真正可用的功能。

---

如遇到问题，请在 [Issues](../../issues) 反馈。祝你游戏顺利、低延迟满帧！🎮

name: oh-my-openagent
body:
**`ulw-research` reads sources in your own browser instead of fetching them.** The Phase 0 brief now decides `Collection: search-only | browser` by one rule (search-only only when a result snippet settles every axis), and the web workers read every candidate through the `browser` skill's attached engine: one named session per worker, one tab per source, several tabs side by side while comparing, with a full-page screenshot per top source. `webfetch` is reserved for raw files, hosts the browser cannot open go to `ultimate-browsing` with their provenance, and a team member's brief names the `browser` skill to read since members cannot carry `load_skills`. `ultimate-browsing` no longer presents itself as the research browsing lane, and the `browser` skill no longer sends plain page reading elsewhere. ([#9958](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9958), [#9959](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9959))

**Your first real prompt starts onboarding, not opening a session.** First-run context now rides along with the first prompt you actually send, without a separate model turn. The agent answers your request first, then offers the tour. Background, preview and headless sessions no longer use up onboarding, the TUI shows a static welcome until you ask something, and a failed or aborted first turn frees onboarding to try again. `--onboard` still starts the tour right away in the TUI, and in RPC it applies to the first real prompt. ([#9905](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9905), [#9907](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9907))

**Custom category models keep their own reasoning settings when background work starts or resumes.** A category with a model override or a `models` chain no longer inherits the builtin category's variant. Reasoning is resolved against the model actually selected before dispatch, with `reasoning` taking precedence over `reasoningEffort` and the legacy `variant`, and a resumed

name: VLOOK
body:
## — What's ✨ NEW —

### ✨ 章节、文库条目支持高亮
- 支持对章节、文库条目设置为高亮（高亮语法：`==内容==`）
- 并导出 HTML 后支持在 [导航中心](https://madmaxchow.github.io/VLOOK/guide3.html#%E5%AF%BC%E8%88%AA%E4%B8%AD%E5%BF%83) 中高亮显示、快速筛选
[…了解详细](https://madmaxchow.github.io/VLOOK/guide.html#%E9%AB%98%E4%BA%AE%E7%AB%A0%E8%8A%82%E6%A0%87%E9%A2%98%E6%96%87%E5%BA%93)

### ✨ 引用块小标题支持左/右侧版式
引用块小标题获得更灵活的版式支持
- 顶部版式：首行设置为「加粗」
- 左侧版式：首行设置为「高亮」
- 右侧版式：首行设置为「斜体」
支持结合 [图片显示版式](https://madmaxchow.github.io/VLOOK/guide.html#%E5%9B%BE%E7%89%87%E6%98%BE%E7%A4%BA%E7%89%88%E5%BC%8F) 支持图文混混排
[…了解详细](https://madmaxchow.github.io/VLOOK/guide.html#%E5%BC%95%E7%94%A8%E5%9D%97%E5%B0%8F%E6%A0%87%E9%A2%98)

### ✨ 图片适配 Dark Mode 增加简化语法
- 举例：
   - 适配 Light / Dark Mode 的图片地址分别为：`pic.jpg` `pic~dark.jpg`
   - 以往写法为 `pic.jpg?darksrc=pic~dark.jpg` 
   - 简化写法为 `pic.jpg?darksrc=~`
- 简化写法中的文件名分隔符支持 `~` `_` `-`
- 同时也兼容 [高清图](https://madmaxchow.github.io/VLOOK/guide.html#%E5%9B%BE%E7%89%87%E9%80%82%E9%85%8D%E9%AB%98%E6%B8%85%E5%B1%8F) `@2x` `@3x` 的语法
[…了解详细](https://madmaxchow.github.io/VLOOK/guide.html#%E5%9B%BE%E7%89%87%E9%80%82%E9%85%8D-dark-mode)

### ✨ 定制主题开放新选项
定制主题提供多种hr分隔线样式选项，应用到正文和导航中心
[…了解详细](https://madmaxchow.github.io/VLOOK/vip.html)

## — What's ♻️ IMPROVED —

### ♻️ iOS 27、macOS 27 适配
- 适配 iOS 26/27 的主流浏览器 UI
- 编辑时、导出 HTML 更灵动的交互动画样式

### ♻️ 文档标题内容自动适配
Markdown 文档中未在 YAML 中指定 `title` 时，对导出的 HTML 标题内容进行自适配处理
- 文档有1个一级章节时，将一级章节的内容作为文档的标题
- 对于设置了 [大封面](https://madmaxchow.github.io/VLOOK/guide2.html#%E5%A4%A7%E5%B0%81%E9%9D%A2) 的文档，有多个一级标题时则优先将封面内容作为标题

### ♻️ 状态栏交互优化
- 在 [幻灯片视图](https://vlook-doc.pages.dev/guide3#%E5%B9%BB%E7%81%AF%E7%89%87%E8%A7%86%E5%9B%BE) 中，增加导航按钮
- 各聚焦状态下（激活灯/聚光灯/章节导航/幻灯片视图/宁静视图），支持按键盘ESC、鼠标点击退出

### ♻️ 更多改进点…
- 导航中心分类索引支持数量角标
- 大封面动效支持鼠标悬停后重新激活
- 完善主题是在编辑时、导出 HTML 样式与交互
- 更新内置主题 Light / Dark 独立样式文件

## — What's 🧯 FIXED —
- 修复一些已知问题

name: qwen-image-local
body:
### 中文

**Turbo 速度档位**：官方蒸馏的 8 步权重，采样比标准 20–40 步快约 3–4 倍。它与显存档位、模型选择相互独立——均衡档和紧凑档都能开 Turbo；无审查模型暂无 Turbo 权重，会自动回落到标准档。应用内（安装界面和主界面）与命令行（`qil setup --speed turbo` / `qil config --speed turbo`）均可选择。

**参考图标注编辑器**：参考图送进模型前可以先画、圈、框、加箭头、擦除或裁剪。9 色预设 + 自定义取色、3 档笔宽、撤销/重做（40 步）、整图 90° 旋转、Ctrl+滚轮缩放，取代原来的旋转按钮。编辑结果另存为新 PNG，绝不修改你的原始文件。

**点击看大图**：参考图和生成结果点击即可放大预览，看的是原图而不是缩略图。

**配置即时保存**：速度选择现在和其他安装项一样，选定即落盘，不点安装也不会丢。

安装包：下载 `Qwen.Image.Local_0.3.0_x64-setup.exe`，双击安装即可。首次启动会检测 GPU、安装引擎并下载权重（约 19.5 GB，仅一次）。

---

### English

**Turbo speed tier**: the official distilled 8-step checkpoint, about 3–4× faster sampling than the standard 20–40 steps. It is independent of the VRAM profile and the model choice — Turbo works on Balanced and Compact alike; the Uncensored model has no Turbo weights yet and falls back to the standard checkpoint. Pick it in the app (setup screen and main UI) or the CLI (`qil setup --speed turbo` / `qil config --speed turbo`).

**Markup editor for reference photos**: draw, circle, box, arrow, erase or crop a photo before it goes into the model. 9-color palette plus custom colors, three brush widths, undo/redo (40 steps), whole-image 90° rotation and Ctrl+wheel zoom — replacing the old rotate-only button. Edits are saved as new PNGs; your original files are never touched.

**Click to zoom**: reference photos and the result open a full-size preview; you see the original, not the thumbnail.

**Instant config persistence**: the speed choice is saved to disk the moment you pick it, like every other setup option.

Installer: download `Qwen.Image.Local_0.3.0_x64-setup.exe` and run it. The first launch detects your GPU, installs the engine and downloads the weights (~19.5 GB, one time).

name: Mole
body:
Mole

Deep clean and optimize your PC.

### Changelog 1. **Status matches macOS**: `mo status` now shows the same dashboard as the macOS CLI, with the health score, the mole, and CPU, memory, disk, power, process and network cards that switch between one and two columns, plus `--json` and `--watch` for scripts, all read straight from Windows without starting PowerShell every second. 2. **Analyze matches macOS**: `mo analyze` opens an overview of your folders and drives, then ranked bars, a largest-files view with `T`, filtering and back navigation with `Backspace`, and `Del` now moves what you pick to the Recycle Bin instead of deleting it for good. 3. **Linked folders stay out of analyze**: junctions and symbolic links are never followed while scanning or deleting, so a link cannot pull a system folder into the list. 4. **Right architecture on ARM**: `mo --version` reports ARM64 on ARM PCs instead of the x64 it saw under emulation. 5. **Ready for package managers**: the release zip now passes winget's archive check, and the manifests follow the current winget, Scoop and Chocolatey rules. ### 更新日志 1. **Status 和 macOS 版一致**：`mo status` 现在和 macOS 版是同一套面板，有健康分、小鼹鼠，以及 CPU、内存、磁盘、电源、进程和网络卡片，窗口窄的时候会自动排成一列，脚本可以用 `--json` 和 `--watch`，数据都直接从 Windows 读，不再每秒拉起一次 PowerShell。 2. **Analyze 和 macOS 版一致**：`mo analyze` 先给出各个文件夹和磁盘的总览，进去之后是按大小排的条形图，按 `T` 看最大的文件，可以筛选，`Backspace` 返回，`Del` 删除的东西改为进回收站，不再直接永久删掉。 3. **Analyze 不会顺着链接走**：扫描和删除时都不跟随 junction 和符号链接，链接不会把系统文件夹带进列表。 4. **ARM 电脑显示正确的架构**：`mo --version` 在 ARM 电脑上显示 ARM64，不再是模拟运行时看到的 x64。 5. **为包管理器做好准备**：发布包现在能通过 winget 的压缩包检查，winget、Scoop 和 Chocolatey 的清单也按各自最新的规范写好了。 ### Install ```powershell iwr -useb https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/Mole/windows/quick-install.ps1 | iex ``` Already installed? ## What's Changed

### iOS 支持

配合 [MicYou for iOS 1.1.2](https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou-iOS/releases/tag/v1.1.2) 使用。新增的协议字段向后兼容，旧版 Android 与 iOS 客户端可照常连接。

* 连接后显示对方是 iOS 还是 Android 设备，Android 客户端同步上报平台 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/f319bdd5894b4c31ea1360a540245867b3bb6a70
* iPhone / iPad 可通过 USB 数据线连接：USB 模式下经 usbmuxd 自动连上手机，只连 iPhone 时无需安装 adb（Windows 需安装 iTunes，Linux 需安装 usbmuxd） by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/c1b8096ab6dffa0b06ad208142ba8a3a8c8ac61a
* 连接期间每秒向手机发送往返延迟、抖动与丢包率，iOS 端在传输界面显示 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/1327613d45e2284965d16c7d3ebbdfd46b934f0c

* USB 模式改为只监听 127.0.0.1 且不再广播 mDNS，Wi-Fi 下的手机无法连上为数据线启动的服务 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/c1b8096ab6dffa0b06ad208142ba8a3a8c8ac61a

* 修复 Windows 端串流后音量环动画持续卡顿 by @OrientCOMPASS in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/pull/367

### 插件

* 撤销 v2.1.0 中原生插件初始化失败后跳过 deinit 与压缩包解压限额，保留市场插件 ID 校验 by @OrientCOMPASS in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/pull/364

* README 加入 iOS 客户端 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/5d78d306e09f02225a6d0fe64cee8e0ad56a1aba

* MirrorChyan 工作流指向 MicYou-Dev 组织 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/6a34e09797c29f8263747c78fe11a71597852117

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/compare/v2.1.0...v2.1.1

name: lazygit
body:
A few bug fixes for regressions introduced with the last release, and also some for older bugs.

One visible change is that the narrow selection bar in the focused diff view is now shown on both sides of the view rather than just on the left. This should improve usability for users with very large monitors, especially when using a side-by-side diff renderer.

For the changes of the last big release, see [v0.66.0](https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/releases/tag/v0.66.0).

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.66.1 -->

## The changes in detail
### Enhancements 🔥
* Allow scrolling the diff view horizontally when gui.wrapLinesInDiffView is off by @stefanhaller in https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/pull/6109
* Show the diff view's narrow selection bar on the right edge too by @stefanhaller in https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/pull/6105
### Fixes 🔧
* Fix staging diff hunks when the diff.mnemonic git config is true by @stefanhaller in https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/pull/6099
* Show errors for unresolvable diff lines by @stefanhaller in https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/pull/6100
* Fix double-width characters in the last column drawing over the view's frame by @stefanhaller in https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/pull/6106
* Fix search match highlighting when a custom patch is active by @stefanhaller in https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/pull/6107
* Open files of a branch's diff from the worktree that has it checked out by @stefanhaller in https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/pull/6104
* Don't log the diff renderer probe in the command log by @stefanhaller in https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/pull/6112


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/compare/v0.66.0...v0.66.1

## 聚合 API、省 Token、降级链与原生 Anthropic 网关

- **聚合渠道（自带 Key）**：注册表内置 76 家提供商（NVIDIA NIM、OpenRouter、Groq、Cerebras、DeepSeek、SiliconFlow、Z.ai、Kimi、MiniMax、QwenCloud、Azure OpenAI，以及免账号的 Ollama、LM Studio、llama.cpp 等）。写入 Key 后其模型以 `provider/model` 进入选择器与本地网关；Key 只写入 0600 的 settings.json，接口永不回显，只显示 `hasKey` 与 `…abcd` 指纹。每家可单独启停、测试（列表探测，不花一次生成）、发现模型、覆盖 Base URL 与模型清单；OAuth/ADC 提供商照常列出并标注「不可驱动」。
- **省 Token**：工具输出压缩（RTK）在请求发出前就地重写 `tool_result`——git diff/status/log、grep、find、ls、tree、构建与包管理器日志、编号转储、搜索清单、重复日志行；实测 40 KB 的 `git diff` 移除 90% 字节且模型仍能就它作答。报错结果永不触碰、替换永不大于原文、过滤器抛错原样放行、整条管线幂等，对全部车道生效，默认开启。另有两族提示词瘦身（caveman / ponytail，默认关）与五个不占上游请求的本地应答（额度探测、命令前缀、会话标题、建议模式、文件路径提取）。
- **路由（降级链）**：把任意车道的模型串成命名链，以 `combo:<name>` 作为虚拟模型出现在选择器与网关上。`fallback` 固定从链首开始，`round-robin` 轮换起点并连续 N 轮粘滞。链接在输出任何正文之前失败会被整段丢弃，切换对调用方不可见——「想了很久才撞上配额墙」正是降级最有价值的场景。
- **本地网关原生说 Anthropic**：新增 `POST /v1/messages`（流式与非流式，含 thinking / tool_use 块、真实 stop_reason 与流内 error 事件）与 `POST /v1/messages/count_tokens`（本地估算）。Claude Code 与 Anthropic 各 SDK 可直接指向本插件；网关页新增「接入客户端」分区，按实际端口与真实密钥生成可复制配方。
- **稳定性修复**：combo 链的降级判定修复——此前候选产出过思考增量后即使失败也不再切换（思考不算交付）；思考块的收尾帧不再被当作提交点；工具调用在 id 迟到的流上不再折叠出重复调用。设置页扩为九页，新增聚合渠道、省 Token、路由三页，并与独立服务架构、图片计价、三套 UI 世界观完成整合。

name: QuickView
body:
# QuickView v6.52.5.0 Pre-Release

> [!NOTE]
> ### 📢 Notice Regarding Development Progress
> Hey everyone, please accept my sincere apologies as updates and active development will be temporarily paused for approximately one month due to an important work commitment that requires my full attention.
> 
> During this period, if you encounter any bugs or unexpected behavior, please feel free to report them in the Issues tab as usual. I will check in whenever I find some spare time; however, I likely won't be able to push out immediate fixes. Once the current task is concluded, I will be back right away to resume active development. Thank you all so much for your continuous support and understanding! ❤️

---

### What's Changed

#### 1. Window State & Shell Controls
* **Seamless Restore on Minimized Activation (#144)**:
  * Resolved an issue where clicking a minimized QuickView window on the Windows Taskbar in custom frameless mode could fail to restore the window and trigger a Windows Shell alert beep.
  * Windows activation messages (`WM_ACTIVATE`) arriving while in an iconic or minimized state now immediately issue `ShowWindow(SW_RESTORE)`, synchronizing state transitions smoothly.
* **Standardized Window Minimization**:
  * Standardized the custom titlebar minimize button to dispatch `SC_MINIMIZE` via `WM_SYSCOMMAND`, aligning with standard Windows shell conventions.

#### 2. Shell Drag & Drop Performance
* **Immediate Drag-and-Drop Lock Release**:
  * Invoked `DragFinish` earlier during `WM_DROPFILES` processing. This releases the exclusive lock held by Windows Explorer (or external drag sources) immediately, eliminating minor interface hangs in source windows and improving drag-and-drop responsiveness.

#### 3. Code Hygiene & Cleanup
* **Removed Redundant Global Variables (#261)**:
  * Cleaned up the unused global variable `g_windowDpi`, keeping the core codebase concise and maintainable.

---

### 💖 Special Thanks to Contributors

name: whatcable
body:
# Charging state you can trust, read live

Beta build for testers. Not recommended for general use.

## Charging state

WhatCable now reads the charging state live from the Mac's System Management Controller (SMC), the chip that runs charging. Before, it waited on macOS's battery record, which can take a minute to catch up.

- After you plug in, the popover shows charging within a few seconds. It no longer says "Plugged in, charging on hold" for the first minute (#634, thanks @official-Cromatin).
- The open popover updates by itself. You no longer need to close and reopen it.
- New: **"Plugged in, charge limit reached"** when macOS has stopped charging at the level it's charging the battery to.
- New: **"Plugged in, running on battery"** when the charger is connected but the Mac isn't taking power from it. It only shows once this has lasted 2 seconds, so the brief blip every Mac has at plug-in never appears.
- The widget and the `whatcable` CLI show the same state as the popover.
- Macs without these SMC keys, desktops included, behave exactly as before.

## Also in here

- Ports: the "USB active" row is gone, because macOS reports it as true on every port. The SuperSpeed row now only shows a live, confirmed USB 3 link (#532).
- The app language setting now reaches the menus too, and macOS's own strings follow it.
- The hardware read that runs every second no longer runs on the main thread, so the popover stays responsive.
- The cable database gains reports #541, #625 and #631.

## What to look at

- Plug in with the popover open: does it say charging within a few seconds?
- If you use a charge limit (or Optimized Battery Charging is holding at 80%): does it say "charge limit reached"?
- Do the widget and the popover agree?
- Did you ever see "Plugged in, running on battery"? Tell me what was plugged in at the time.

Install by downloading WhatCable.zip below, unzipping, and dragging WhatCable.app into /Applications over your existing copy.

# BoxPlayer v5.0.36 本次更新集中完善统一媒体库与音乐体验：统一各页面海报与详情页布局，改进首页和文件来源的拖动排序，补齐系列、播放列表与分类浏览；音乐库改为歌曲、歌手、专辑和自建歌单入口，并改进粒子播放器的切换；Trakt 支持系统浏览器登录、待看列表和个人评分同步。 ## 统一媒体库与首页管理 - 主屏幕、分类、搜索结果和媒体服务器列表采用统一的海报尺寸、圆角、标题与年份布局，改进封面清晰度。 - 收藏夹使用彩色卡片，音乐、书籍与媒体服务器显示对应图标；补齐系列入口并去掉重复的收藏夹管理项。 - 首页管理支持拖动整行调整顺序，保存栏目顺序和显示设置；二级管理页面与一级页面保持一致宽度。 - 文件来源列表可直接拖动右侧手柄进行整行排序；网格选择「重新排序」后显示卡片抖动提示。 - 媒体库初次加载显示加载指示，改进空状态，删除列表顶部多余的说明文字。 - 修正继续观看卡片的本地进度比例，卡片底部显示清晰的橙色播放进度条。 ### 主屏幕 ![BoxPlayer v5.0.36 统一媒体库主屏幕](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gaozhangmin/boxplayer/v5.0.36/screenshot/library-home.png) ## 媒体详情与分类浏览 - 扩大详情页背景图展示区域，去掉右侧独立圆角容器，统一底部内容对齐与按钮圆角。 - 修复暗色模式无背景图时出现白色区域的问题，调整简介与评分的间距。 - 有历史进度时，播放按钮显示进度及「继续：时间」提示。 - 媒体库与媒体服务器的集封面中央增加播放入口，简化重复的季标题。 - 系列和播放列表共用选择弹窗；海报菜单与详情页使用相同的选择界面，更多操作收纳到下拉菜单。 - 改进类型、年份、地区和演员的分类筛选与页面标题，从分类页返回时恢复原详情页。 - 移除媒体库详情页底部冗余的「详细信息」区块。 ### 剧集详情 ![BoxPlayer v5.0.36 剧集详情与播放入口](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gaozhangmin/boxplayer/v5.0.36/screenshot/episode-detail.png) ## 媒体服务器与文件来源 - Emby、Jellyfin、Plex 使用各自的品牌图标，服务器支持自定义图标。 - 调整编辑共享与选择封面的入口，非媒体服务器来源不显示选择封面菜单。 - 新增服务器端点管理弹窗，支持添加、编辑和选择不同连接地址。 - 统一服务器海报列表、收藏分类与媒体操作的展示。 ### 媒体服务器海报列表 ![BoxPlayer v5.0.36 媒体服务器海报列表](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gaozhangmin/boxplayer/v5.0.36/screenshot/server-library.png) ## 音乐库与粒子播放器 - 音乐库提供歌曲、歌手、专辑与我的歌单四个入口，支持搜索、创建歌单及从列表播放。 - 播放歌曲或「播放全部」时进入粒子播放器；返回音乐库后仍可通过底部播放条控制和再次进入。 - 修正队列标题显示全部歌曲、弹窗却只展示当前歌曲附近少量曲目的问题；现在可以滚动查看完整队列。 - 改进音乐元数据与封面展示，并保留歌词、音效及粒子可视化设置。

## Trakt 登录与同步 - 点击 Trakt 图标后直接打开系统浏览器授权，并通过应用回调完成登录。 - 登录后可将待看列表增删和个人评分同步到 Trakt；操作期间显示加载反馈，菜单按当前状态切换加入或移除。 - 账户弹窗展示用户名、头像、观看统计、同步开关与退出登录；修复弹窗宽度跳变和头像加载时的白色占位。 - 登录凭据由主进程加密保存；Trakt client_id 统一从本地环境配置和 Gi

name: snow-apps
body:
# Snow Shot / Snow Shot Mini 1.2.6

## 更新内容

- **测量与标注更灵活**：新增角度测量，距离标注可按校准后的数值修改；文字支持粗体、斜体，标注颜色预设可自定义，水印内容可跨截图保留。
- **公式与表格识别更方便（完整版）**：LaTeX 识别结果可预览、编辑；表格和公式识别可选择视觉模型。
- **贴图更好用**：可设置贴图阴影，隐藏、恢复贴图窗口，改善窗口大小与内容的匹配。
- **截图更流畅、更省内存**：改善选区拖动与显示的流畅度，空闲时减少内存占用；再次截图时，光标显示更稳定。
- **日常操作更稳定**：改善序号文字样式、设置修改、长菜单和弹窗关闭，修复更新下载进度显示。

## What's new

- **More flexible measurement and annotation:** measure angles, edit distances by their calibrated value, use bold and italic text, customize color presets, and remember watermark text across captures.
- **Easier formula and table recognition (Full edition):** preview and edit recognized LaTeX formulas, and choose a vision model for table and formula recognition.
- **Better pinned images:** customize shadows, hide and restore pinned windows, and get improved sizing around their content.
- **Smoother capture, lower idle memory use:** smoother selection dragging and display, less memory use while idle, and more consistent cursor display when taking another screenshot.
- **Everyday reliability:** improved numbered text styles, settings edits, long menus, popup dismissal, and update download progress.

## macOS 快速安装 / Install on macOS

需要 macOS 15 或更新版本，在终端执行。/ Requires macOS 15 or later. Copy into Terminal.

**Snow Shot**

```sh
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.2.6_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh
```

**Snow Shot Mini（仅 Apple Silicon / Apple Silicon only）**

```sh
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.2.6_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh --edition mini
```

# 🚀 Escrcpy 3.3.1 — Unlock Existing Features, Embrace a New Chapter

Escrcpy 3.3.1 is a **transitional release** that bridges the gap between the existing version and the new billing and licensing system planned for Escrcpy 4.0.0 and later.

To ensure a smooth transition, **all existing features in Escrcpy 3.3.1 are available for free**, with no purchase, activation, or license verification required. This is a long-term policy for the existing version, not a limited-time promotion.

This release also improves the stability of embedded mirroring and application startup workflows.

## ✨ What's New

### 🔓 All Existing Features Unlocked

Due to adjustments to our billing platform and subscription system, all existing features in Escrcpy 3.3.1 are now available for free.

This policy is intended to help existing users transition smoothly to the new version strategy. You can continue using all features available in Escrcpy 3.3.1 without additional payment.

### 🖥️ Embedded Mirroring & Virtual Displays

- Introduced preliminary support for launching applications on virtual displays and using embedded mirroring.
- Improved the stability of application startup logic related to embedded mirrored virtual screens.
- Fixed abnormal mirroring control parameters when launching applications through shortcuts.
- Fixed an application launch issue affecting some Windows users.

### 🤖 Copilot Configuration

Copilot now requires users to configure a supported AI model provider, including the relevant API key, endpoint, and model settings.

If no provider is configured, the interface prompts users to complete the setup instead of automatically using the previous built-in service.

Please note that third-party AI model providers may charge for API usage according to their own pricing policies.

Due to adjustments to the billing and subscription system, users running Escrcpy 3.2.0 or earlier may encounter license verification

name: superpowers
body:
We rebuilt brainstorming from scratch so it does a much better job of what it was always for: helping you work out what you actually want and put it into words before anything gets built. The new skill asks you to describe what you're after and why, plays back what it heard so you can correct it, and keeps asking good questions until the picture is clear. Then it matches the process to the work, from just doing it to writing a full design. 

This release also adds a native plugin manifest for the Antigravity Marketplace and fixes Windows hook discovery, Git Bash paths, Hermes skill descriptions, and several smaller bugs.

### Brainstorming

- **Brainstorming draws out what you want before it proposes anything.** Its first message offers to skip the questions and asks one open question about a real moment or a concrete picture. It offers a menu only when you're stuck. Along the way, it offers to look at prior art, your project, or the web. As it understands each part, it plays that part back in a few hundred words and marks its guesses as guesses. (#2463)
- **It sizes the work after it understands what you want, and says so in plain words.** It does a quick, clear task right away, agrees a small change with you in chat, and writes a design document for a project. You can override its call, and it steps up a size if the work grows. (#2463)
- **A builder check replaces the spec-document reviewer.** A fresh subagent reads the design as the person who'll build it and lists what they'd still need to ask. Brainstorming answers what it can, makes the minor calls itself and marks them as its own, and brings you the questions that change what gets built, in one round. (#2463)
- **It finds out which choices about how the thing gets made you want to own.** Platform, language, libraries, medium: if you have strong views, it talks them through; if you hand them over, it picks sensible defaults and tells you what it picked. Apollo-Reborn
body:
### Features

- Add an **in-app update prompt**: from the next release on, Apollo Reborn checks for updates once a day and, when one is out, lets you send it to AltStore, SideStore, Feather, or FlareStore or download the IPA, with the release notes a tap away (#1343: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Tap **Later** or **Skip this version** to put it off, check any time with **Check for Updates** (About), or turn off **Automatic Update Checks** (Privacy, on by default); jailbreak installs don't check
  - What's New now shows the app icon you picked instead of the default one
- Open the **subreddit switcher** as a native sheet when you tap a feed's title, with search, your favorites, and live results, instead of the small floating dropdown; typing a multireddit like apple+iphone still works (#1313, #1387: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Press and hold the **Posts** tab to open it while a feed is open, now on Liquid Glass too, and the search field stays in place as you scroll the sheet
- Add a **Liquid Glass** switch (Interface → Appearance, on by default) so Liquid Glass builds can use Apollo's classic look without installing a different IPA; quit and reopen Apollo for the change to apply (#1384: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Shown on Liquid Glass builds on iOS 26 and later, except inside LiveContainer; while it's off, Liquid Glass-only options are hidden
- Add a **Minimize** Hide Style for **Hide Bars on Scroll** (Interface → Tab Bar, Liquid Glass) that shrinks the tab bar into a small glass pill showing the current tab as you scroll, like Safari; tap the pill or scroll back up to bring the full bar back (#1349, #1384: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - With any Hide Style on Liquid Glass, a tab bar or header hidden by scrolling now slides back in when you open a page or go back or forward, and the tab bar no longer comes back on its own after 30 seconds

name: Auto_Bangumi
body:
# [4.0] — Beta

4.0 是插件化重构的大版本：下载、通知、解析、搜索、重命名与整理都通过同一套扩展点实现，内置功能与第三方插件走相同的接口。下载器可以有多个实例，重命名、硬链接、种子过滤与媒体库刷新由内置插件提供。只支持从 3.3.x 升级，第一次启动时自动迁移配置并备份原文件。

升级步骤、回滚方法与升级后的检查项见 [从 3.3 升级到 4.0](../deploy/upgrade-4.0)。

## 4.0.0-beta.1

Docker 镜像：`ghcr.io/estrellaxd/auto_bangumi:4.0.0-beta.1`（`dev-latest` 也指向最新测试版）。

### 破坏性变更

- **只支持从 3.3.x 升级。** 检测到更早版本的数据（`config/version.info` 低于 3.3，或残留 2.x 的 `data/data.json`）时拒绝启动，并提示先升级到最新的 3.3.x 启动一次。
- **配置结构变化，自动迁移。** 下载器改为 `plugins.instances` 中的实例，`plugins.slots.downloader` 指向默认实例；重命名方式与版本冲突策略移到 `plugins.slots.rename_strategy` / `plugins.slots.conflict_policy`。第一次启动时自动迁移 3.3 的 `downloader`、`bangumi_manage.rename_method`、`bangumi_manage.revision_conflict_policy`，原文件备份为 `config.json.v3.bak`（已有备份时另存为 `config.json.v3.bak.1` 等，不覆盖）。迁移失败时 `config.json` 保持原样、拒绝启动，日志写明出错的字段。`AB_DOWNLOADER_*`、`AB_DOWNLOAD_PATH`、`AB_METHOD`、`AB_REVISION_CONFLICT_POLICY` 环境变量照常生效。
- **通知渠道旧字段。** Bark 不再读取 `token`（改用 `device_key`），WeCom 不再读取 `chat_id`（改用 `webhook_url`）。升级时自动迁移。
- **移除旧 API。** 3.2 兼容的 GET 控制端点（`/api/v1/restart`、`/start`、`/stop`、`/shutdown`）和 `GET /api/v1/auth/refresh_token` 已移除，请改用 POST。
- **移除旧配置。** 移除 `experimental_openai` 配置节与通知的单渠道旧字段（3.3 已迁移到 `llm` 与 `notification.providers`）；移除废弃的 `normal` 重命名方式，已有配置自动改为行为相同的 `none`。
- 数据库自动升级到 schema v26（新增插件存储表与 `downloader_id` 列）。

### 插件系统

- 新增插件运行时：插件可以来自内置目录、签名插件目录、本地目录（`config/plugins/local/`）或 pip 包。本地与 pip 插件未签名，需开启 **设置 → 插件 → 允许未签名插件**（`plugins.allow_unsigned`）才会加载。
- 插件可以提供下载器、通知渠道、LLM 解析提供商、搜索站点、元数据源和定时任务。内置的 qBittorrent / aria2 与各通知渠道走同一套扩展点。下载器类型、通知渠道、订阅解析器的下拉框会列出插件提供的选项。
- 插件可以在 RSS 下载流程中过滤种子、修正解析结果、修改保存路径 / 分类 / 标签，或为私有站点的请求添加 Cookie 等请求头。
- 设置页新增「插件」卡片：查看状态、启停插件，并通过自动生成的表单修改插件配置；秘密字段在读取接口中一律掩码。
- 签名插件目录：`GET /api/v1/plugins/catalog` 列出目录中的插件，`POST /api/v1/plugins/{id}/install` 验证 sha256 与 ed25519 签名后安装并启用，`DELETE /api/v1/plugins/{id}` 卸载。
- 插件的钩子调用有超时。同一插件连续失败 5 次后被自动禁用，修复后在设置页重新启用即可。

### 多下载器

- **设置 → 下载设置** 可以添加多个下载器实例（qBittorrent、aria2 或插件提供的下载器）并指定默认实例。
- 规则与 RSS 订阅可以选择下载器，留空时用默认实

name: iPhoneMirror
body:
iPhoneMirror 1.8.5-pre → 1.8.5-pre2 完整更新日志

发布日期：2026-10-09。版本性质：预览版。

对比范围：`v1.8.5-pre`（54c36cad597e995dbfb3999de42287082d22cce9）到 `v1.8.5-pre2`（5a260d7e25e040481959ff86913341e7db24b97a）。
本清单根据发布标签的实际代码差异、CHANGELOG 的新增记录及对应功能文档整理。下列修复是实现变更，不表示所有设备和网络场景都已完成实机验收。

## 一、新增首次设置助手与设置检查

- 新增首次设置助手，涵盖基础偏好、应用模式、外观、使用方式、设备配置、无线组件和画质设置。
- 支持无线投屏、有线投屏、投屏与反控等不同用途，按选择跳过不需要的功能。
- 设置助手仅首次启动自动显示；首次显示即保存进入记录，未完成也不会在每次启动时重复弹出。
- 保留应用偏好、投屏设置和开发者选项中的手动入口，保留未完成进度和已有设备档案。
- 每次手动进入先检查实际设置，再显示汇总；支持重新检查、处理缺项及重新配置全部设置。
- 按已完成、未完成、无效、不需要、未知区分结果；设备离线或检查超时不再被视为全部就绪。
- 检查 Apple 服务与驱动、USB 后端、接收组件、设备绑定、蓝牙环境、设备信任、开发者模式及所需无线同步设置。
- 新增只读驱动诊断与设备端设置检查；检查本身不安装驱动、不主动配对、不下载或挂载 DDI，也不发送控制输入。
- 可明确关闭 USB 控制、无线投屏/控制或蓝牙控制，相应检查项按“不需要”处理。
- 多设备按身份分别配置，新设备独立进入待配置列表；扫描不擅自删除旧绑定。
- 修复设置后只重新检查受影响的项目，按依赖进入下一项，不重复扫描无关硬件或逐页重放检查动画。
- 支持步骤跳过、返回、取消、关闭确认和断点保存；设置保存失败时保留当前步骤并显示错误。
- 已安装组件和已有设备绑定可直接复用；更改无线设置时按实际需要重新启动接收器。
- 保存逐设备画质偏好，包括有线显示、帧率和解码设置。
- 检查和汇总共用卡片与行控件，状态原位更新，减少阶段切换跳动；支持长列表、窗口尺寸变化及系统动画偏好。
- 设置期间暂停主窗口自动刷新，退出后恢复完整、精简或托盘模式。

## 二、新增本地自动化 API

- 在开发者工具中新增本地 Automation API，默认关闭，仅监听 `127.0.0.1`，默认端口为 17890。
- 提供设备列表、设备详情、连接与反控状态、能力和画面几何信息查询。
- 提供设备截图、点击、长按、按下/抬起、滑动、触摸路径、按键、文本输入及剪贴板读写接口。
- 提供离线 API 文档、OpenAPI 3.1 描述以及 Python、curl/PowerShell 示例。
- 使用 API Key 和细分权限；凭据采用当前 Windows 用户的 DPAPI 保护。
- 校验请求来源与 Host，限制请求速率、正文大小、路径点数、截图并发和连接数。
- 新增按设备排他的控制租约；支持续租、释放、到期回收，以及界面上的手动收回控制。
- 同一已绑定手机的 USB/AirPlay 身份共享控制所有权，多设备分别管理租约。
- API 输入与手动操作、键位映射、快捷键使用同一输入准入规则，避免互相抢占。
- 使用实际采集画面像素坐标与已有校准映射，画面尺寸、会话或校准变化后旧几何信息失效。
- 截图复用原生采集帧，编码移出 UI 线程；并发请求可共享同一编码任务。
- 桥接器新增剪贴板 RPC 能力；剪贴板读取不模拟复制键，纯写入不自动发送粘贴键。
- API 复用已建立的投屏和反控连接，不自动安装驱动、下载 DDI 或启动其他传输方式。
- 蓝牙 API 能力按实际键盘通道报告，不宣称支持绝对坐标触摸或任意 Unicode 剪贴板功能。

## 三、键盘、输入会话与重连修复

- USB/无线反控重新连接后恢复独立预览窗口的键盘路由与输入所有权。
- 自动更新 Windows 键盘钩子，修复钩子被系统静默移除后鼠标可用但键盘和快捷键失效的问题。
- 钩子恢复时同步修复按键录制和映射状态，清理漏收到的修饰键释放事件。
- 恢复时仍按住的按键保持隔离，直到实际松开，避免意外重复输入。
- 串行管理控制桥启动与停止，停止时取消尚未完成的启动，忽略旧进程的迟到输出和退出回调。
- 区分各次桥接会话的输入生命周期，旧会话的排队输入和剪贴板请求不能进入新会话。
- 修复排队输入取消、标准输入阻塞导致关闭卡住、进程复用和迟到回调问题。

- 修复探索页热度轮播在窗口变宽后出现空白且部分区域无法点击的问题
- 修复窄屏下缓存选集快捷按钮被挤压或无法完整显示的问题，空间不足时自动换行
- 修复部分界面文案中的引号和撇号显示多余反斜杠的问题
